verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents diff comparison with feedback left alongside the code, and stacked pull requests that let reviewers break large changes into separately reviewed commits. Third-party integration in the review screen is limited to Buildkite builds appearing as checks on pull requests, which is CI status rather than code quality reports. Missing for 10: explicit large-diff handling (collapsing, lazy loading, file filtering), display of third-party code quality reports or annotations in the review screen, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
